relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.place: Mahavijjodaya Chaung Monastery on the Sagaing Hills
relations.evidence: He was ordained under Sayadaw U Pannavata at the Mahavijjodaya Chaung Monastery on the Sagaing Hills and given the Dhamma name Sīlānanda.

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.evidence: He travelled to University College Columbo and passed GCE Advanced Level Examinations with distinctions in Sanskrit and Pali.

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.evidence: In 1960, he became the chief abbot of the Mahavijjodaya Chaung monastery, where he had been ordained as a novice monk.

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.evidence: In 1968, he moved to Abyarama Shwegu Taik monastery in Mandalay, and presided as chief abbot.

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.evidence: He taught Buddhist scriptures at Sagaing's Atothokdayone Pali University and Mandalay Arts and Sciences University

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.evidence: He taught Buddhist scriptures at Sagaing's Atothokdayone Pali University and Mandalay Arts and Sciences University

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.evidence: He taught Pali language at Mandalay University, too.

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.evidence: In 1999, at the request of Sitagu Sayadaw, he agreed to become rector of International Theravada Buddhist Missionary University, opened in the same year.

relations.subject: Ashin Nandamalabhivamsa
relations.evidence: He was succeeded by Ashin Nandamalabhivamsa after his death in 2005.
